Examples: linking a study finding to an author's claim about screen time, mapping an expert quote to a point about animal rights, matching historical accounts to a claim about the cause of a battle, connecting a percentage to a point about climate data, linking a definition to a claim about technical concepts, matching experimental results to a point about chemical reactions, pairing a personal testimony with a claim about community service, mapping a source citation to a point about health. Constraints: Ensure the activity requires identifying the exact span of text that contains the supporting evidence.
